description: Take a source out of the company brain's queue, once what it says is in the wiki. Call it after folding a source into pages yourself — otherwise it stays queued, the nightly job digests it again in its own way, and writes over what you did. It is what closes the loop when you do the ingesting rather than leaving it to that job. Marking one already digested is not an error, and requeue_wiki_source undoes it.

source_id.description: The source's id, as listed by list_wiki_sources.

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug, from any Monnet URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b'). Call list_workspaces if you do not have it.

name: mark_wiki_source_ingested
